name: personal-long-job-supervisor
description: Run long local commands in detached process sessions and resume Codex only for durable terminal or attention events.

interface.longDescription: Launch long Linux, macOS, or Windows commands in detached process sessions, persist worker-side disk and heartbeat observation plus Linux NVIDIA GPU observation across MCP disconnects, and resume Codex only for bounded durable events.
interface.defaultPrompt: Discover capabilities, report the expected duration, declare an observation contract, supervise this authorized long command without model polling, and report the actual duration when it ends.
